derivation: as if feminine of a derivative of G3962 (πατήρ);
def: paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation)

occurrences.text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
